The '''Security Belt''', commonly referred to as the '''thermal credit belt''', was used by [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] and [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] to securely carry [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] about their person. Worn flush around the stomach, the Security Belt had four fabric pouches that absorbed body heat and projected it on the outside in an effort to confusing security scans.<ref name="PSG" />
